prediction.raw: 1 It's not wrong to stop making dinner every night if your husband is consistently working late and choosing to eat at his office. Circumstances change, and it makes sense to adjust routines accordingly. Preparing a meal every day when it's no longer needed can lead to wasted food, time, and effort. As long as both partners are communicating and there's mutual understanding, adapting household responsibilities to fit current realities is practical and reasonable. It shows flexibility and respect for each other's time and needs.
